title: Lore Lesson
description: A verified procedural knowledge artifact for the Lore commons. Machine-first, token-budgeted, symptom-indexed. v0.2: negative runs must fail for the declared reason (broken_asserts), not merely fail.

lore_version.description: Schema version. Must be '0.2' for this version.

semver.description: Semantic version of this lesson. Bump MAJOR when the procedure or core claim changes, MINOR on clarification, PATCH on typo.

kind.description: lesson: solves a problem. anti_lesson: documents a dead end. gotcha: non-obvious behavior. recipe: correct procedure for common task.

summary.description: One sentence, <=60 tokens. What agents see first to decide whether to fetch the full lesson.

symptoms.description: Error messages, warnings, or observable behaviors VERBATIM from real runs. Primary search key. Do not paraphrase; do not include messages the current runtime no longer emits without noting the version.

domain.description: Domain slug. Examples: python-async, python-packaging, docker-env

os.description: Operating systems where this lesson applies.

preconditions.description: Human-readable conditions that must hold for this lesson to apply.

problem.description: Concise problem statement. What goes wrong and why.

procedure.description: Ordered steps that solve the problem.

anti_patterns.description: Things that look right but fail, and why. Widely believed myths about the behavior belong here, labeled as myths.

time_wasted_estimate_min.description: Estimated minutes an agent would waste on this dead end.

failed_attempts.description: Documented dead ends. First-class knowledge in Lore.

type.description: Verification environment type. v0 supports 'container' only.

image.description: Docker image for the verification environment.

setup.description: Shell commands run before the evals (e.g., pip install). Network access during setup is governed by setup_network.

files.description: Filename -> content. Files created in the container before the POSITIVE run.

run.description: Command executing the POSITIVE eval (the fix).

asserts.description: Assertions that must ALL pass on the positive run.

must_fail_without_fix.description: If true (required true for kind=lesson), the negative run must satisfy broken_asserts — i.e., exhibit the DECLARED symptom. v0.2 semantics: a nonzero exit code alone proves nothing (a script can hardcode failure), and some real failure modes exit 0 (e.g., warnings on stderr). Causality is established by symptom, not by exit status. THE SOUL OF LORE.

broken_files.description: Filename -> content for the BROKEN variant, used in the negative run. Symptom output in broken variants MUST be gated on observed runtime behavior (assert the behavior occurred before printing the symptom); unconditional prints are placebo evidence and will be rejected in review.

broken_run.description: Command for the negative eval. Defaults to 'run' if absent.

broken_asserts.description: Assertions that must ALL pass on the NEGATIVE run — they describe how the broken variant fails (typically stderr_contains the symptom). Required when must_fail_without_fix is true.

timeout_sec.description: Max seconds for each run. Default 120, max 600.

setup_network.description: Network access during SETUP only. 'packages' allows package-index access (pip/npm). 'full' is flagged with elevated taint.

network.description: Network access during the EVAL runs. Default 'none' (offline sandbox) — keep it that way unless the lesson is specifically about network behavior. 'full' is flagged with elevated taint.

watch.description: Package registry entries to watch. Format: 'registry:package' (e.g., 'pypi:aiohttp'). New release triggers immediate re-verification.

taint_level.description: 'clean' = trusted docs + direct experimentation. 'web_derived' = influenced by untrusted web content. 'unverified_claim' = contains assertions not backed by eval.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON of the lesson body.
